notes.title: Update 1 - New Boss and more levels
notes.notes:
10 new levels from 31 to 40: Now you have 10 new levels to adventure, and at level 40 a new boss is ready to test your skills.

1 new boss MechaBull: He is a high-tech robot used to monitor João Meat's farms, you will be the first to test the full power of MechaBull, so be careful with this robot's jumps and horns.

https://i.imgur.com/v09X3ZX.png

Adjustment of the game's pause menu: the old version was less intuitive and lacks the button to go to the menu. So these modifications were made to improve the navigation of the game's interface.

Control adjustment: Xbox and Playstation controls now work without non-standard button inputs.
